target.name: MDBT42Q
target.controlPort: /dev/ttyUSB0 through FTDI FT232R A50285BI at 9600 baud
target.applicationRegion: 0x1f000 through the reserved Storage boundary at 0x6c000

toolchain.source: scripts/provision.sh MDBT42Q selected the pinned EspruinoBuildTools ARM GNU Toolchain 13.2.Rel1 archive
toolchain.optimization: MDBT42Q release -Os with section garbage collection and link-time optimization
toolchain.commonFlags: BOARD=MDBT42Q RELEASE=1 DFU_UPDATE_BUILD=1 USE_XFSM=1 USE_JIT=0 USE_DEBUGGER=0 USE_TAB_COMPLETE=0 USE_NETWORK_JS=0 USE_NFC=0 SETDEFINES=<NO_VECTOR_FONT> -j2

profile.description: Constrained Bluetooth profile retaining Bluetooth, filesystem, graphics, network/HTTP, crypto/SHA-256, and NeoPixel while omitting JIT, debugger, tab completion, vector font, JavaScript-backed networking, and NFC

execution.flashMethod: Espruino Web IDE Advanced Flash from File over the board bootloader Bluetooth connection
execution.testCommand: paced direct UART runner on /dev/ttyUSB0 at 9600 baud
execution.traceCommand: compose with run_trace_test.py, execute directly or from temporary Storage, then compare the captured transcript with --observed-output
execution.storageBackedReason: Large conformance source was evaluated as a flash-backed Storage string so test text did not displace the maximum-depth runtime workload from the finite JsVar pool
execution.storageCleanup: The temporary xftmp.js source and the disposable .bootcde image were erased; final Storage.list() was empty

productionFirmware.verification: runtime identity and public XFSM exports verified after DFU flash

canonicalTraces.comparison: exact normalized comparison with reviewed traces generated by the pinned XState 5.33.2 and 4.38.3 references
canonicalTraces.largeTraceLoading: COMPAT-006 and DIAG-006 used temporary flash-backed source; all other traces ran directly

maximumDepth.sourceLoading: paced direct runner and temporary Storage source

targetSpecificUnavailableMetrics.nativeHeap: MDBT42Q does not expose ESP32.getState() native-heap fields; JsVar, arena, allocation, stack, timing, flash, and cleanup metrics are recorded instead.

embeddedExclusions.reason: The desktop source is intentionally too large for the constrained test heap; test_strict_validation_embedded.js passed.
The Linux-only 65,535/65,536-byte string harness is not practical on this target; applicable depth, microstep, stack and production-memory boundaries passed.

artifactRetention.binaries: Transient local copies under /tmp/xfsm-mdbt-artifacts; hashes and sizes retained in this record, binaries not committed.
artifactRetention.consoleLogs: Transient raw logs under /tmp/xfsm-mdbt-prod, /tmp/xfsm-mdbt-instrumented, and /tmp/xfsm-mdbt-traces; reviewed results retained here.

changes: read GPIO output latch state through Pin.getInfo().output where digital input sense is unavailable
calibrate diagnostic pressure to the finite target pool
release completed action-trace actors before independent negative cases
evaluate oversized conformance source from temporary Storage
fixturePortabilityChanges.hostRegression: 22 normal Linux suites and nine canonical traces pass; the physical native-heap pressure fixture remains MCU-specific by design

decision: The constrained Bluetooth MDBT42Q product profile satisfies the applicable Profile 1 physical-target criteria.
